title: Review ingest implementation and skill packaging
description: Review the complete changeset: ingest command in memory.py (argument parsing, chunking logic for all four formats, skip logic, stderr output), SKILL.md (frontmatter correctness, completeness of body sections, accuracy of command signatures), apm.yml (field completeness, version correctness), and test suite (coverage completeness, mock correctness, base class pattern adherence). Flag any pending decisions from the spec that were resolved implicitly without documentation.
acceptance_criteria: Ingest argument parsing matches the spec CLI signature exactly
All four format handlers (txt, md, json, csv) are present and handle error cases
SKILL.md body covers all five required sections
apm.yml contains all required fields with correct types
Test suite covers all ten test classes from the spec
Any spec pending decisions resolved during implementation are noted in code comments or SKILL.md
